title: arnica mollis var. silvatica
intro: Arnica mollis var. silvatica, commonly known as Mountain Arnica, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been used for its therapeutic benefits, particularly for its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which can help alleviate pain, reduce swelling, and promote wound healing. The health benefits of Mountain Arnica include soothing muscle and joint pain, reducing inflammation, and accelerating the healing process of minor injuries. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
